ospedale: Then I started treatments at the Ospedale Maggiore for bending the knees, mechanical treatments, baking in a box of mirrors with violet rays, massage, and baths.

That was in the Ospedale Maggiore in Milano, Padiglione Ponte.
The X-ray was taken at the Ospedale Maggiore and the doctor who did it was excitable, efficient and cheerful.
